name: AI Security: Defending LLM Applications
summary: AI systems fail in new ways. Learn where they are exposed and build the defences that hold.
prerequisites: Requires prompt engineering. No offensive security background assumed.
syllabus: How LLM applications fail, mapped as an attack surface
Hallucination, bias and fairness as risks
Content moderation and knowing who uses the model
Defences: validation, schemas, allowlists and limits
Tool isolation, least privilege and human confirmation
Threat modelling, and instructions kept apart from material
Authorisation and conversation memory around the model
Secrets, budgets and choosing a model provider
Operating it: monitoring, regression tests, incidents and governance
